flawed_step: Step 3: Concluding that the Hamiltonian cycles in the induced neighbourhoods can be chosen compatibly and combined into one cycle through every vertex of the graph.
assessment_summary: Step 1: For each vertex v, G[N(v)] has a cycle containing every neighbour of v; this is the definition. Step 2: A proof would need to obtain one cycle containing all vertices of G. Step 3 is unjustified: the local cycles may be incompatible, and the definition supplies no mechanism ensuring that they combine into a global spanning cycle. The proof attempt therefore stops at this first unsupported implication.
